citation.authors: Hibbs SP, Aiken L, Vora K, Mowete C et al

cited_by.title: A low white cell count that may be Duffy-null (neutrophil count)

record.population: Phase 3 cancer trials for prostate, breast, melanoma, colorectal and lung cancers, 2021-2023
record.design: Cross-sectional analysis of trial exclusion criteria and chemotherapy dose-modification rules
record.finding: Of 289 eligible trials, 221 (76.5%, 95% CI 71.1-81.2) excluded patients whose neutrophil counts were within the Duffy-null reference range. Colorectal trials had the highest exclusion proportion (86.4%), prostate the lowest (47.8%).
